name: Guile
title: Le sillage du Sonic Boom
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW vertical 4:5 premium Kalistar character illustration, illustration alone without frame, text, title or UI. Guile from Street Fighter at the instant after releasing a Sonic Boom. IMPORTANT CAMERA: step BACK to a generous three-quarter/full-figure view, showing his head, torso, hips, both knees and most of his combat boots with breathing room above his head. NOT a bust portrait, NOT a chest closeup. His whole silhouette and the luminous air arc must be readable together. Serious expressive mature face, unmistakable blond flat-top, olive tank top, dog tags, camouflage trousers, worn military boots. His weight is planted in a grounded fighting stance, body turned three quarters, both arms spread naturally to the sides after the release, elbows softly bent, normal human joint structure, properly proportioned forearms, no swollen bulging arms or shortened limbs. Hands may naturally extend slightly outside left/right edges if necessary: never distort anatomy to squeeze them into the frame. A single large pale gold and icy ivory Sonic Boom crescent sweeps diagonally across the foreground, clearly legible as a moving curved blade of compressed air, passing in front of the lower torso without hiding his face or entire figure. This arc is a key part of the composition, NOT a halo or multiple decorative swirls. Keep the surrounding background quiet: broad muted concrete airfield ground and one distant hangar silhouette in soft mist; no vehicles, crowds or busy detail. Established Kalistar art direction: rich narrative digital painting, palpable brush grain, chiselled painted color planes, scuffed fabric and metal, dramatically modelled cinematic light, weathered heroic fantasy materials adapted to his recognizable military costume. Painterly not photographic, not smooth CGI, not anime, not flat comic, no fisheye, no extreme perspective. Strong emotion of disciplined controlled power. Natural human anatomy and spacious composition have priority over fitting every fingertip within the picture.
